data.title: 在原七海 · 桌面上的标记
data.description: 桌上的地图被几张便签压住。七海将一枚标记移到新的位置，确认不会挡住旁边的重要路线。
data.action: placing a marker on a paper map
data.promptProse: Inside a quiet tactical briefing room, Nanami leans over an extensive paper topographical map spread across a solid wood planning table, carefully adjusting a small acrylic route marker. The focused warm cone of light from an adjustable brass desk lamp illuminates penciled notes and colored sticky tabs, while the shadowed background reveals map cabinets and subtle blueprint rolls on wall shelves.
